# In_Network_Aggregation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The process of combining data or events within network nodes rather than at endpoints, often inspired by biological aggregation. Enables energy-efficient neuromorphic processing by reducing data movement and leveraging emergent collective behavior.
